code='''from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    background = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    special_rows = {r for r in range(h) if len(set(grid[r])) == 1 and grid[r][0] != background}
    special_cols = {c for c in range(w) if len({grid[r][c] for r in range(h)}) == 1 and grid[0][c] != background}
    return [[2 if (r in special_rows or c in special_cols) and grid[r][c] != background else grid[r][c]
             for c in range(w)] for r in range(h)]
'''
